comment: The design of the derived part edit UI test (mitcad#1812, tools/ui-derived-part-edit-test.sh): the profile of the test's library (LIBRARY_URL, replaced by the test) placed by BUILD on the origin, 500 mm long in its default row Small (20 x 20 x 500 = 200000 mm3), its derived part DerivedComponent1; and a component Block with a 10 mm cube and its bounding solid BoundingSolid1 (a feature type without an edit panel), 1000 mm3 each.
